Man Dragged Behind Scooter Over Debt in Andhra Pradesh

In Andhra Pradesh's Bhogapuram, a man was allegedly beaten and tied to a scooter, then dragged. Police reported that the accused removed his shirt, used ropes around the victim's hands and neck, and dragged him. The incident reportedly occurred over a debt of Rs 30,000, though one report specified Rs 11,500.
